tasks.label: Sprint: countdown
args: $deadline = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse('2026-07-19T00:06:00-07:00'); $remaining = $deadline - [DateTimeOffset]::Now; if ($remaining.TotalSeconds -le 0) { Write-Host 'SPRINT DEADLINE PASSED' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; Write-Host ('Remaining: {0:00}h {1:00}m {2:00}s | Deadline: 2026-07-19 00:06 PDT' -f [math]::Floor($remaining.TotalHours), $remaining.Minutes, $remaining.Seconds) -ForegroundColor Cyan

tasks.label: Demo: verify recorded case (CLI)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $output = @(& python -m marketleak.cli_v3 review-case --config 'configs/phase15/polymarket_btc65k_review_case.json' --as-of '2026-07-14T00:38:53.861000Z' --case-uid 'review:polymarket-btc65k-cocaptured' 2>&1); $cliExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; $output | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; if ($cliExitCode -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Recorded demo CLI exited with code {0}.' -f $cliExitCode); exit $cliExitCode }; try { $payload = ($output -join [Environment]::NewLine) | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Recorded demo CLI did not return valid JSON: {0}' -f $_.Exception.Message); exit 1 }; $failures = [Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); if ($payload.status -cne 'available_precomputed_review_cases') { $failures.Add('status must be available_precomputed_review_cases') }; if ($null -eq $payload.case -or $payload.case.case_uid -cne 'review:polymarket-btc65k-cocaptured') { $failures.Add('case UID does not match the frozen recorded case') }; if ($null -eq $payload.case -or $payload.case.routing.decision -cne 'abstain_insufficient_evidence') { $failures.Add('routing decision must be abstain_insufficient_evidence') }; if ($payload.not_proof_of_fraud -ne $true) { $failures.Add('not_proof_of_fraud must be true') }; if ($payload.effectiveness_unknown -ne $true) { $failures.Add('effectiveness_unknown must be true') }; if ($payload.read_only -ne $true) { $failures.Add('read_only must be true') }; if ($payload.live_fetch -ne $false) { $failures.Add('live_fetch must be false') }; if ($payload.live_inference -ne $false) { $failures.Add('live_inference must be false') }; if ($failures.Count -gt 0) { $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Verification failed: {0}' -f $_) }; exit 1 }; Write-Host 'Recorded demo verification passed.' -ForegroundColor Green
